text: Totems like company. One that is used stays **Answered** for about 40 minutes of loaded time. After that it turns **Dim** for another 40 minutes, and matching stations work about 30% slower. Then it falls **Quiet**, and new work may pause even with Pulse to spare.

Waking a totem is easy: right-click it with an empty hand, or use a **Bone Chime** on it. Drumming a Drumheart by hand within 8 blocks wakes it too. Once awake, a totem stays awake while a station of its voice works nearby.

Some things keep totems awake for you. A [familiar](familiar_attuning) carrying a totem's voice keeps it awake from up to **8 blocks** away, a tribe's Drummer wakes any totem near its beat, and a [Kinship Totem](kinship_totem) never goes quiet.
Totems in the open, near water and plants, stay awake twice as long. A totem under a roof keeps the normal pace.

A totem also needs Pulse in its own buffer. On a lattice network with Pulse in it, it fills and sits full; off the lattice it drains in about two minutes and falls **silent**, awake or not. A new totem starts full, so put a [Lattice Conductor](lattice_conductor) in reach before then.

pages.title: Where to read more
text: The full rules are on the [Keeping](keeping) page. If a station has stopped and its power is fine, a quiet totem is the usual reason, and the Codex will tell you when you crouch and right-click the station.
